title: WEDM System Integrity — Zero Gaps, Full Wiring, Complete Coverage
philosophy: Mathematical and statistical perfection requires: (1) ZERO inline physics constants — single source of truth in constants.ts; (2) 100% engine wiring — every engine reachable via dispatcher; (3) Full test coverage — every formula validated against published data. This milestone closes all gaps found in the forge audit.

phases.title: Constants Consolidation — Single Source of Truth
phases.rationale: Inline constants cause drift. All physics values must import from EDM_PHYSICS.

phases.title: Orphan Engine Wiring — Autonomy Layer
phases.rationale: 59 engines exist but are unreachable. Wire Phase 4 autonomy/safety engines to edmDispatcher.

phases.title: Test Coverage — Physics Validation
phases.rationale: 36% coverage is insufficient for safety-critical code. Add tests for all physics engines.

phases.title: Statistical Validation — Published Data Verification
phases.rationale: Every formula must be validated against published literature values ±15%.

U-INT-01.title: Refactor WEDMCompleteOrchestrationEngine to import from EDM_PHYSICS
U-INT-01.description: Replace inline MATERIAL_RA_MODELS, ENERGY_CASCADE_GAMMA, K1, eta with imports from src/physics/constants.ts. Delete duplicate definitions. Run tests to verify no regression.
U-INT-01.exit_criteria: Zero inline physics constants. All values import from EDM_PHYSICS. Tests pass.

U-INT-02.title: Audit all WEDM engines for remaining inline constants
U-INT-02.description: Grep all WEDM engines for magic numbers: k_ra, K1, eta, gamma, 0.25, 0.38, 4.8, 0.40. Any found must be replaced with EDM_PHYSICS imports.
U-INT-02.exit_criteria: Zero inline physics constants across all WEDM engines.

U-INT-03.title: Wire autonomy engines to edmDispatcher (10 engines)
U-INT-03.description: Add dispatcher actions for: WEDMAutonomyEngine, WEDMRLControllerEngine, WEDMKalmanFusionEngine, WEDMHierarchicalPlannerEngine, WEDMFaultDiagnosisEngine. Each needs wedm_ prefixed action.
U-INT-03.exit_criteria: 5 new actions wired and documented. Actions callable via MCP.

U-INT-04.title: Wire safety engines to edmDispatcher (5 engines)
U-INT-04.description: Add dispatcher actions for: WEDMDegradationModelEngine, WEDMRULEngine, WEDMSafetyEnvelopeEngine, WEDMFailsafeEngine, WEDMVirtualMachineEngine.
U-INT-04.exit_criteria: 5 new actions wired. Safety engines accessible via MCP.

U-INT-05.title: Wire remaining orphan engines (44 engines)
U-INT-05.description: Batch wire remaining 44 orphan engines. Group by functionality and add to appropriate dispatcher.
U-INT-05.exit_criteria: All 59 orphan engines wired. Orphan count = 0.

U-INT-06.title: Add tests for EDMMultiPassStrategyEngine physics
U-INT-06.description: Test Toenshoff energy cascade, pass count optimization, Ra prediction vs Klocke. Validate against published 4-pass D2 programs.
U-INT-06.exit_criteria: ≥15 test cases. Ra predictions within ±15% of Klocke. Pass counts match published data.

U-INT-07.title: Add tests for EDMMonitorSurfaceIntegrityEngine
U-INT-07.description: Test Carslaw&Jaeger recast prediction, AMS 2628 compliance gate, surface integrity metrics.
U-INT-07.exit_criteria: ≥10 test cases. Recast predictions validated. Spec compliance gates working.

U-INT-08.title: Add tests for EDMCuttingParamFlushEngine
U-INT-08.description: Test pulse parameter derivation, published condition lookup, material interpolation, wire safety limits.
U-INT-08.exit_criteria: ≥20 test cases. All pulse params validated against Klocke/Lemhunter published data.

U-INT-09.title: Add tests for EDMMaterialMachineWireEngine
U-INT-09.description: Test material/wire compatibility, machine spec lookup, galvanic risk matrix, published machine data integration.
U-INT-09.exit_criteria: ≥15 test cases. All 9 published machines validated. Galvanic matrix covered.

U-INT-10.title: Validate all Klocke Ra predictions against published literature
U-INT-10.description: For all 8 materials in EDM_PHYSICS.klocke.ra_models, compute Ra for standard conditions (I_p=10A, t_on=5µs) and verify within ±15% of published Klocke/Puertas data.
U-INT-10.exit_criteria: All 8 materials validated. Mean error <10%. Max error <15%.

U-INT-11.title: Validate DiBitonto crater model against real offset data
U-INT-11.description: Compare DiBitonto-predicted offsets against ITW SHAKEPROOF real program offsets (H1-H4). Validate K1=4.8 produces correct crater/gap predictions.
U-INT-11.exit_criteria: Offset predictions within ±15% of ITW SHAKEPROOF. K1 validated.

U-INT-12.title: Validate Kunieda MRR against published feed rates
U-INT-12.description: For all materials in EDM_PHYSICS.kunieda.eta, compute MRR and derived feed rates. Validate against Lemhunter published speeds.
U-INT-12.exit_criteria: Feed rates within ±15% of Lemhunter. All eta values validated.

exit_gate.formula_validation: All physics formulas ±15% of published data
